_about: Routing eval (docs/routing.md): questions carrying another feature's words, with the route each must take. Routes: emergency, guard, alert, map, facility_count, facility_named, facility_nearest, place_area, place_pin, outbreak, outlook, hazard, planner (the planner's document path and its own tools). Run: uv run python evals/routing/run.py. The two 1 Nov 2026 live misroutes are r01 and r26.
